exact_target: Number of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between low-temperature (LT) and normal-temperature (NT) groups: total 12,059 DEGs, with 6,737 up-regulated and 5,322 down-regulated.

location_evidence.quote: A total of 12 059 differentially expressed genes and 131 differentially expressed metabolites were obtained, which were mainly concentrated in the signal transduction and phenylpropanoid metabolic pathways.
A total of 12 059 DEGs were obtained, of which 6737 genes were up-regulated and 5322 genes were down-regulated. The results are shown in Table 2 .

conclusion_criterion: Conclusion agreement is scored only when the numerical criterion is met or when the publication states a directional claim that the observed value can be compared with; otherwise the conclusion component is not_assessable.
